_comment: nodeSourceBase/distrolessBase are the reviewed, registry-resolved source digests pinned once by the maintainer (node:22-bookworm-slim + gcr.io/distroless/cc-debian12). runtimeImage/proxyImage are the PUSHED manifest-list digests, written atomically by 'security:images -- --push <registry>' (a maintainer/CI step). For local builds the immutable reference is the local image ID from `docker image inspect --format '{{.Id}}' agentoctopus/skill-runtime:test`; the placeholder digests below are never consumed locally because the local lane passes OCTOPUS_TEST_RUNTIME_IMAGE/OCTOPUS_TEST_PROXY_IMAGE.
